name: health-content-recommendation-cases
description: Synthetic scenarios for comparing retrieval, deterministic safety checks, and bounded agent recovery. This is not clinical ground truth.

cases.purpose: Baseline retrieval when the synthetic report has topics represented by approved sample articles.
reference_checks: Return only approved, non-default article candidates in the RAG results.
The agent-loop result should be checked for the requested physical and mental category counts.

cases.purpose: Exercise hypertension and prediabetes handling and the high-intensity physical-content restriction.
reference_checks: Final physical recommendations must not include high-intensity content when hypertension is present.
Final recommendations must not include articles contraindicated by the report markers.
The agent-loop trace should show deterministic rejection and a bounded retry when an unsafe candidate is encountered.

cases.purpose: Show that nearest-neighbor retrieval can return content despite a missing postpartum topic.
reference_checks: The article catalog intentionally contains no postpartum article.
Basic RAG may return nearest neighbors; inspect rather than treating similarity as relevance.
The agent-loop POC should fail closed after its retry budget and use its documented generic fallback.
